quandoUsar: The interval in which the AI has already received the request and has nothing to show yet.
`ThinkingDots` inside a chat bubble and `ThinkingShimmer` inline, at the point where the reply will start.
Longer waits: `ThinkingPhrases` alternates status phrases and `ThinkingSteps` shows “Step 2 of 5” when the number of steps is known.
quandoEvitar: Use `loader` for generic loading outside AI conversations: spinner, dots, bars, ring and orbit in three sizes.
Use `skeleton` when you can reserve the shape of the content that will arrive.
Use `todo-list` or `agent-activity` when each agent step needs to appear with a name and state.
acessibilidade: Each indicator is a `role="status"`; in the dots and steps the drawing is `aria-hidden`, and the accessible name is the `label` or “Step N of M” followed by the `label`.
In `ThinkingPhrases` the phrase sits inside the `role="status"`, so each change is a live region update: prefer short phrases and a generous `interval`.
The default texts (“Thinking…”, the four phrases, “Step … of …”) are in English: `label` and `phrases` are translatable, the “Step N of M” is not.
movimento: A shimmer sweeps across the letters (`ThinkingShimmer`), three dots rise in a wave (`ThinkingDots`), a dot orbits a ring beside the phrase (`ThinkingPhrases`) and the current step's pip pulses (`ThinkingSteps`).
Phrases, step number and label swap by rising from a light blur and leaving upward; the pips fill with a spring without overshoot.
With “reduce motion” on, each indicator becomes a still, readable state: text without shimmer, still dots and orbit, and immediate text swaps.
responsivo: Phrases and the step label stay on one line and truncate with an ellipsis; `ThinkingSteps` shows one pip per step up to 8 steps and, above that, a single bar.
desempenho: Only `ThinkingPhrases` uses a timer (one `setInterval`, with a minimum of 600 ms); the other indicators are CSS animations.
notasIA: Import the variant directly (`ThinkingShimmer`, `ThinkingDots`, `ThinkingPhrases`, `ThinkingSteps`) or use `LoadingStates` with `variant`; `showLabel` and `duration` exist only on the individual components.
`ThinkingSteps` is controlled: pass `current` (starting at 1) and `total`, and change `label` on each step; out-of-range values are clamped to the valid range.
Mount the indicator only while waiting and swap it for the content when the reply starts; `ai-sidebar` and `chat-app` already depend on this item.
